# Signal Loom synthetic archive

This entirely invented archive contains seven unchanged Markdown records and no real people, study responses or participant project material. Only records are potential retrieval inputs; this README and labels are not.

Frozen version phase_1_gold_v1 assigns stable SY-R01–SY-R07 IDs in the [benchmark record catalogue](../temporal_state_benchmark/public_benchmark.json). Original filenames and source text are unchanged.

- **Latest production state:** closure record SY-R07, dated 20 February 2026. All seven records are eligible for each of the six canonical sections.
- **Historical diagnostic state:** active snapshot SY-R05, dated 12 February 2026. Only SY-R01–SY-R05 are eligible. SY-R06 is an unplaced, undated fragment whose prior availability cannot be proved; SY-R07 is later closure. Both are excluded.
- **Undated fragment diagnostic:** uses the latest state, not the active historical view. A stable filename ordinal is not an invented creation date.

This corrects the v2 active view's inclusion of the undated fragment. It prevents later or temporally unplaced source evidence from entering the earlier state. Labels for active and closed views remain distinct even when the same words occur in both.

Closure/no-next-task, explicit feedback absence and named-issue resolution already exist in the sources. No new closure sentence or stable-ID header was added. Named drift resolution supports its diagnostic negative answer but does not automatically settle the broad production question about all remaining limitations.

All case annotations were manually reviewed and researcher-confirmed by Fuzhe Zhang on 25 October 2026; they are frozen as phase_1_gold_v1. No embeddings, summaries, retrieval outputs or participant review events are supplied.
